title: Thinking on Confidence & Feelings of Success, Failure and Achievement
summary: Kahran and Divya pick up the success-failure thread from earlier episodes and ask why success more often produces imposter syndrome while failure produces real confidence — because confidence requires knowing you can recover, not that you'll never fall. They use Adam Neumann's WeWork-to-Flow arc, Kahneman's optimism bias in founders, and the American obsession with Little League as evidence for how achievement culture warps the loop.
topics: public failure and how others read you
achievement culture in America and India

intents.display: to think about why failure builds confidence and success doesn't
